Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit ONLY the six plant cells9–14 in this exact existing COLOURFUL16-piece dungeon sprite sheet. Preserve all existing three-hue material palettes, crystals in cells1–4, mushrooms in cells5–8, root loops in cells15–16,4x4 layout, positions, baselines and transparency. IMPORTANT USER CORRECTION: do not make all six plants ferns. Cells9–11 must be THREE distinct low FERNS. Cells12–14 must be THREE distinct plain GRASS TUFTS. Never wheat or grain.
SMALL-SCREEN REDESIGN: these plants will be only4–12pixels tall at runtime. Strong simple SILHOUETTES and broad colour blocks are essential. Remove micro-detail that vanishes: no tiny veins, stippling, hairs, delicate serrations or dozens of leaflets. Painterly game art, NOT pixel art or vector icon art, but use a bold economical silhouette that downsamples well. Each FERN has just2–3 arching broad fronds with3–4 LARGE pairs of chunky pinnae per frond, and at most1 broad curled shoot. Three different spreads: compact fan, slightly asymmetric splay, low wide clump. Each GRASS TUFT has4–6 clearly separated broad tapered blade shapes from a shared small base: one upright, one fanned, one bent low. Blades only: ABSOLUTELY NO wheat ears, grain, seed heads, fuzzy plumes, tassels, flower stalks or cattails. No ground discs, bases, pedestals, extra roots, rocks or added scenery.
Keep the CURRENT complementary triad colours and area character. Every plant needs2–3 BROAD clearly different hue blocks that remain visible when reduced: one main frond/blade group in main hue, another broad group/underside in the supporting hue, a compact base or curled shoot in the accent hue. Not a single-hue plant with tiny nearly invisible accent dots. Keep overall mid-dark with restrained accents and enough value contrast to separate adjacent lobes. Simplify surface brushwork and preserve the currently established palette on every other sprite.
Each piece remains inside its own256px cell, local x46..210 and y65..224, with bottom on baseline y224. Side view standing up; tiny ankle-height dungeon dressing. True alpha-zero transparent background and clean holes between blades/fronds, no coloured matte residue, no glow halo, cast shadows, directional light, text, numbering, guides or grid. Same square1024x1024 RGBA sheet,16 populated cells. Change only the six foliage cells.
